context_summary: User requested planning F04 to address technical debt items ACT-06 (batch upsert), ACT-07 (concurrency+resume), ACT-08 (collector integration tests) identified in retroactive review D-20260818-001. These are prerequisites before scaling data collection to all MTG sets.

options_considered.description: Plan F04 as a dedicated tech debt feature covering ACT-06, ACT-07, ACT-08 only. Focused scope, clear acceptance criteria.
pros: Clean separation from feature work — easier to review and test
All three items are tightly related (collector scaling readiness)
Unblocks full-catalog backfill which is the next major milestone
Also absorbs remaining Wave 0 items (ACT-01 through ACT-05, ACT-09, ACT-10) as low-cost hygiene
cons: Ceremony overhead for what is essentially cleanup work

options_considered.description: Plan F04 as ACT-06/07/08 plus also start Phase 4 REST API in the same feature to deliver visible value alongside the debt.
pros: API would immediately benefit from the batch/concurrency improvements
cons: Scope creep — mixing infra debt with new feature increases risk
API design decisions deserve their own PRD and planning cycle

rationale: ACT-06/07/08 are tightly coupled (all collector-layer scaling concerns) and form a natural feature boundary. Mixing in REST API would create scope creep and dilute the focus. The debt must be resolved before scaling to all sets, making this the critical path. Remaining minor debt items (ACT-01-05, 09-10) should ride along as Wave 0 hygiene since they are trivial.
